landingPage.metaTitle: Focuspilot — Operating system for interior design studios
landingPage.metaDescription: Unify projects, CRM, finance, and AI-powered inbox for your studio. Fewer tools, clearer margins, calmer delivery.

hero.subtitle: Unify projects, clients, procurement, and finance. Give your team one calm place to run the studio — with AI that clears the inbox instead of adding noise.
hero.proof1: Fewer fragmented tools for principals, PMs, and finance
hero.proof2: Built for multi-project studios, not single-task todo apps
hero.proof3: Security-minded: your client and financial data stays yours
hero.mockAiSummary: Summary: supplier confirmed lead times for oak flooring…

product.title: One spine for the whole studio
product.subtitle: Focuspilot is where your job data stops living in inboxes and ad-hoc sheets. Principals see reality, PMs ship faster, and finance finally matches what happens on site.
product.creativeOpsBody: Workflows that respect approvals, revisions, and supplier chaos — not generic “tasks”.
product.clientGradeBody: Documents and proposals that look like your studio — not like a generic CRM.
product.scaleBody: From small teams to multi-location studios adding seats and projects over time.

features.title: Everything you expect — without the tool sprawl
features.subtitle: Deep modules tuned for studios that juggle procurement, FF&E, contractors, and high-touch clients.
features.projectsTasksDesc: Kanban, timelines, and deliverables that mirror how studios actually work — so nothing slips between tools.
features.crmDesc: Contacts, pipeline, and polished proposals with clear scope and line items your clients can trust.
features.financeDesc: Invoices, purchase orders, and visibility into margin without exporting spreadsheets every Friday.
features.aiInboxDesc: Turn noisy email into actions — summaries, follow-ups, and context surfaced next to the right project.
features.calendarDesc: Milestones, installs, and meetings in one view — fewer “which date did we promise?” moments.
features.reportsDesc: Revenue, time, and project health without building a data warehouse. Answers for principals and PMs.

workflow.title: From first brief to final invoice
workflow.subtitle: A clear path your team can repeat — so every project feels less improvised.
workflow.step1Body: Bring in your team, branding, and finance setup — Xero and Gmail-ready when you are.
workflow.step2Body: Boards, files, and client comms stay tied to the job — no more hunting across five tabs.
workflow.step3Body: From quote to PO to invoice — traceability studios need for tight margins and happy clients.

quote.textBefore: We didn't need another generic project app — we needed

cta.title: Ready to run a calmer studio?
cta.subtitle: Join teams who've traded duct-taped stacks for one calm operating layer. Start in minutes — bring projects, email, and finance when you're ready.

footer.tagline: The operating system for interior design studios — projects, clients, finance, and team workflows in one place.

pricingPage.metaDescription: SaaS subscription tiers for interior design studios: Starter, Professional, and Enterprise. Plus add-ons and services.
pricingPage.heroSubtitle: SaaS subscription model with tiered pricing — pick the capacity and depth that matches how your studio operates.
pricingPage.trialNote: All plans include a 14-day free trial. Prices exclude VAT where applicable; annual billing discounts and add-ons are available on request.
pricingPage.trialNoteSuffix: if your studio already has an account.
pricingPage.streamsSubtitle: Beyond core subscriptions, Focuspilot is designed for expansion through features, services, and long-term partnerships.
pricingPage.ctaTitle: Ready to align your team on one platform?
pricingPage.ctaSubtitle: Create a workspace, invite your studio, and upgrade tiers as you grow.
pricingPage.revenueSubtitle: Subscription-first, with optional services as you scale.

saas.title: Recurring SaaS revenue
saas.body: Monthly and annual subscriptions. Target: 80–100 studios within 12 months; indicative Year 1 ARR £150–300k.

premium.title: Premium features
premium.body: Advanced AI tools (£49–99/mo add-on), extra storage, dedicated onboarding (£2–5k one-time).

services.title: Implementation & training
services.body: Studio setup and migration £1–3k per studio; team training workshops £500–1,500 per session.

partner.title: Partner revenue
partner.body: Resellers, API licensing, and an integration marketplace as the ecosystem matures.
